title: RV & Boat Storage Rent Discount Programme: Autopay, Prepayment and Second Space
content:
RV & Boat Storage offers three rent discounts: a fixed monthly autopay credit while rent is paid by automatic ACH, a percentage off rent prepaid for a set term, and a percentage off the rent of a customer's second storage space.

## Figures by space class

| Space class | Monthly autopay credit (USD) | Prepayment terms offered | Discount on rent prepaid for 6 months | Discount on rent prepaid for 12 months | Discount on the rent of a second storage space |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open Compact Storage Space | 2.00 | 6 or 12 months | 5% | 10% | 10% |
| Open Standard Storage Space | 3.00 | 6 or 12 months | 5% | 10% | 10% |
| Open Large Storage Space | 4.00 | 6 or 12 months | 5% | 10% | 10% |
| Covered Standard Storage Space | 5.00 | 6 or 12 months | 5% | 10% | 10% |
| Covered Large Storage Space | 6.00 | 6 or 12 months | 5% | 10% | 10% |
| Enclosed Storage Unit | 10.00 | 6 or 12 months | 5% | 10% | 10% |

**Unused prepaid months on move-out (every class).** The prepay discount is recomputed for the months actually used, and unused whole months are refunded.

## Notes

- The autopay credit is a fixed amount per month that differs by class; the prepayment and second-space discounts are percentages of rent and are the same percentages in every class.
- Prepayment is offered only for the two terms listed, 6 months and 12 months.
- Hypothetical figures on a monthly rent of 72.00: 5% of it is 3.60 and 10% of it is 7.20. On a hypothetical monthly rent of 239.00: 5% is 11.95 and 10% is 23.90.
